about: Play front page discovery data (ruling side D2 brief, 21 Nov 2026). build.py joins this to the catalogue by route: every catalogue game needs exactly one row here and every row must be a catalogue game. Titles are a cross-check only; the page shows the catalogue title. Moods, hooks, packs, the Today pool and search words are curated here and nowhere else. A cover is any picture under /assets/play2/covers/; its bytes are pinned in covers.
